name: huge
note: the unified front end over several estimators with a path of penalties and a selection rule

name: huge.generator
note: simulated data from graph structures (random, hub, cluster, band, scale-free) with the true graph

name: huge.select
note: selection of the path point by RIC, StARS or an extended BIC

name: huge.inference
note: confidence intervals and tests on the edges of a precision matrix (the debiased lasso)

name: huge.roc
note: ROC of edge recovery along the path and the graph plots

name: huge.plot
note: ROC of edge recovery along the path and the graph plots

name: huge.npn
note: the nonparanormal transformation (Gaussian copula marginals by truncated ranks): a graphical model for non-Gaussian data

name: huge.ct
note: correlation thresholding: edge by a threshold on the correlations

name: huge.mb
note: Meinshausen-Buhlmann neighbourhood selection: one lasso per node, edges by an AND or OR rule

name: huge.glasso
note: the unified front end over several estimators with a path of penalties and a selection rule

name: huge.tiger
note: TIGER: tuning-insensitive graph estimation by scaled lasso on the correlation matrix, with a penalty that needs no tuning
